messages.text: Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner DC02 scrypt dogecoin litecoin

At 16¢, the DC02 sips 25 W — about $2.90 a month in power. That's the whole running cost.

What you're buying is the draw: solo, it's roughly 1 in 21,000 a day at a 10,000 DOGE block (~$1,500), so about a 1.7% shot over a year — and the machine keeps drawing after every miss. Point it at a pool instead and it just drips Doge/LTC steadily.

It's $239.99, 105 MH/s, WiFi setup. Want me to check stock for your plug and build the cart?
